last_material_result: Bounded substitute/data validation passed. Fresh Korean search results show multiple interactive airport parking-fee calculators and many static mode-comparison guides, but no direct substitute surfaced that combines private-car fuel/toll + multi-day airport parking + discount eligibility against taxi, limousine bus and AREX on a household/party-size basis. The closest calculators stop at parking fees and explicitly send users to separate taxi/fuel calculators, preserving the integration wedge. A zero-paid-API v1 is feasible: use three editable Seoul origin bands rather than live routing, user-editable round-trip driving distance/toll/taxi/limousine/AREX access values, and official/published airport parking tariff logic. Parking discount materially changes crossover economics: standard long-term parking is published at KRW9,000/day, while common eligible groups receive 50% and low-emission class 3 receives 20%, so a 7-day stay changes parking by roughly KRW31,500 at 50% discount before fuel/toll. This is enough to shift the drive-vs-other-mode boundary. Competition risk remains moderate because generic airport transport content is abundant, but the direct interactive household crossover answer remains differentiated enough for a KRW0 static build.
